quantity.description: A Kubernetes quantity, for example 500m, 2 or 1Gi.

description: gitops/tenants/<tenant>.yaml: a tenant that clusters can onboard. A cluster lists the tenant in cluster.yaml; the tenant component renders its namespaces, AppProject, ResourceQuota, LimitRange and Application.

description.description: Who the tenant is, in one sentence.

limits.description: LimitRange of each namespace of the tenant: the container defaults.

name.description: Tenant name. Must be equal to the file name. It is also the AppProject name and the folder tenants/<tenant>/ in the gitops repo. The platform AppProject names (platform_projects in policy/data/gitops.yaml) are reserved: the tenant policies skip those projects.

namespaces.description: Namespaces of the tenant, the only destinations of its AppProject. schemas:check fails if a namespace is not the tenant name or does not start with <tenant>-, starts with kube-, or is the namespace of a catalog component.

quota.description: ResourceQuota of each namespace of the tenant.

title: GitOps tenant
